en.name: Han River: Bridges at Blue Hour
en.short_description: A 5 km westbound virtual row from Banpo toward Wonhyo Bridge.

ko.name: 한강: 블루아워의 다리
ko.short_description: 반포에서 원효대교 방향으로 가는 5 km 가상 로우입니다.

experience.water_state: light wind ripple; no wave or current modifies workout facts
experience.design_rule: All landmarks are geographically registered, while meshes, vegetation density, boats, light levels, and route-safe offsets are original virtual presentation.

beats.camera_intent: A low, forward-facing reveal beneath a broad bridge span; begin with calm water and a generous sky.
Use three softly glowing, contemporary island volumes as a distant upstream look-back—not an exact architectural replica.
Pass through a quieter structural rhythm; the bridge makes a strong visual cadence without narrowing the virtual row line.
Shift attention to an island-side tree canopy and a low cultural-venue glow. Keep the main channel visually open.
A broad bridge approach gives the row a mid-route crescendo; reflections are restrained so HUD values remain readable.
Resolve on a wide downstream vista. At the endpoint, hold the boat at the finish presentation position while the PM-backed workout continues.
